policy: A dataset being publicly accessible does not automatically grant permission to use every document for model pretraining. Only dataset versions whose exact license is documented and compatible with the conservative trainer allowlist may be staged. Human review remains mandatory.

candidate_sources.name: Mozilla Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0 - Korean
format: MP3 audio (not used by this text-only pipeline)
candidate_sources.evidence: Mozilla Data Collective dataset listing identifies Common Voice Scripted Speech 27.0 - Korean, locale ko, license CC0-1.0, dataset size 208.48 MB at time of review.
limitations: ASR prompt sentences are not a balanced general-knowledge corpus
short sentences must be grouped into documents
only sentence column is retained; speaker IDs and demographic metadata are discarded
official train and dev splits are kept separate; official test split is never imported

candidate_sources.name: Korean Language Corpus 2025 (National Institute of Korean Language)
candidate_sources.evidence: Official corpus portal describes individual corpus collections and per-corpus access requests; some listed 2025 resources describe copyright-cleared or commercially usable source materials, but exact terms are collection-specific.
limitations: verify the selected corpus's own terms and permitted model-training use
portal currently displays partial service maintenance notice

excluded_sources.name: Open Korean Historical Corpus Hugging Face dataset
excluded_sources.reason: NonCommercial license is not accepted by this project's conservative training allowlist; excluded even though the dataset description discusses public-domain source materials.

excluded_sources.name: Korpora package repository
excluded_sources.reason: Repository license applies to the package and its accompanying materials; individual corpora have separate licenses. No corpus is approved based on the repository license alone.

excluded_sources.name: AI-Hub collections
excluded_sources.reason: AI-Hub has collection-specific access agreements, attribution, no-redistribution and other conditions. Not admitted under the current generic CC0/CC-BY manifest policy without collection-specific legal and policy review.

excluded_sources.name: Wikimedia Wikipedia dumps
excluded_sources.reason: Wikipedia text is generally CC BY-SA; current trainer allowlist excludes ShareAlike pending separate legal and technical policy review.

excluded_sources.name: Stack Exchange public data
excluded_sources.reason: Version-dependent CC BY-SA terms require post/revision-level attribution and ShareAlike review; not admitted by current trainer allowlist.

excluded_by_default: arbitrary web crawls with unclear rights
unreviewed synthetic text presented as factual source material
